== Biography ==

Father William is known to Wonderland through a poem in which a young man addresses the elderly gentleman regarding his remarkable physical prowess. Despite his advanced age and snow-white hair, Father William maintains a peculiar devotion to standing upon his head, a practice he has pursued since his youth. When questioned about the safety of such activity at his age, Father William explains that he once feared it might injure the brain—but having since assured himself that he possesses none, he sees no reason to discontinue the practice. The poem also notes that Father William has grown most uncommonly fat, and records an instance of him performing a back-somersault at the door.
